derivedFrom.⚑ theHashIsNotStableAcrossCommits: THE DERIVED HASH MOVES WHEN THE LEAN ASSEMBLY MOVES, and it has moved before within a single day. `emissionSha256` is the real anchor: if a future re-derivation disagrees with `vk.hash`, check that sha FIRST.
